parts.name: Root
parts.description: The container with the state. It holds the open state and the reference to the trigger. It gives the state functions ({ close, open, toggle, isOpen }) to its children snippet.

props.name: open
props.description: The open state. By default it goes in the two directions: use `bind:open`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state at the start, for when you give no `open`.

props.name: controlledOpen
props.description:
Give your own code full control of the open state. The component stops to write back to
`open`, and it reports only through `onOpenChange`. Thus the parent can refuse a change: the
parent does not send the new value down. The default is off, because `bind:open` is the usual
case and it needs the write-back.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The component calls it when the open state changes.

props.name: triggerRef
props.description: The reference to the trigger element. Set it in your own code, or let Dialog.Trigger set it.

props.name: children
props.description: The children snippet. It receives the state functions: { close, open, toggle, isOpen }.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: The button that registers itself as the trigger of the dialog. A click opens and closes the dialog.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the button.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the button.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the button element.

parts.name: Portal
parts.description: The portal that puts the dialog layers in the document body. They are there only while the dialog is open, and they stay until the exit animation is complete.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the portal: the Overlay and the Content.

parts.name: Overlay
parts.description: The backdrop behind the dialog content. Its z-index comes from the position of the dialog in the stack.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the overlay.

dataAttributes.name: data-entering
dataAttributes.description: Present while the enter animation operates.

dataAttributes.name: data-exiting
dataAttributes.description: Present while the exit animation operates.

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: "open" while the dialog is open, "closed" during exit.

parts.name: Content
parts.description: The modal panel, with role="dialog" and aria-modal. It keeps the focus inside, it obeys an interaction outside it, it stops the page scroll, and it hides the outside content from assistive technology. In a stack, only the top dialog obeys the close interactions.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the dialog.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the dialog container.

props.name: shouldCloseOnInteractOutside
props.description: Closes the dialog when the user clicks outside it.

props.name: shouldCloseOnEscape
props.description: Closes the dialog when the user pushes the `Escape` key.

dataAttributes.name: data-dialog-positioner
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the fixed element that puts the panel at the center.

dataAttributes.name: data-entering
dataAttributes.description: Present while the enter animation operates.

dataAttributes.name: data-exiting
dataAttributes.description: Present while the exit animation operates.

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: "open" while the dialog is open, "closed" during exit.

props.name: children
props.description: The name of the dialog.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the heading.

props.name: id
props.description: Replaces the id that the component makes.

dataAttributes.name: data-dialog-title
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the heading that names the dialog.

props.name: children
props.description: The text that a screen reader announces after the title.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the paragraph.

props.name: id
props.description: Replaces the id that the component makes.

props.name: children
props.description: The name on the button.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the button.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the button element.

dataAttributes.name: data-dialog-close
dataAttributes.description: Identifies a button that closes the dialog.
